findings.evidence: Exact structural precedent in Mathlib: `Mathlib/FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Adjoin/Basic.lean:66` `theorem forall_mem_adjoin_smul_eq_self_iff … : (∀ x ∈ adjoin F S, m • x = x) ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, m • x = x`. Also `Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:205 forall_mem_image`, `Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:584 forall_mem_range`.
findings.fix: Rename to `forall_mem_center_reverseEven_eq_self_iff` (and update the use at line 149).
findings.issue: `forall_reverseEven_eq_self_on_center_iff` renders the bounded hypothesis `x ∈ Subalgebra.center K (even Q)` as the preposition `on_center`. The naming dictionary maps `∈` to `mem`, and the predicate follows the bound set. The same file writes the membership as `_of_mem_center` on lines 73/129/137, so the spelling is also internally inconsistent.

findings.evidence: Line 147: `∃ x : even Q, x ∈ Subalgebra.center K (even Q) ∧ reverseEven Q x ≠ x`. The same file names the equality case `reverseEven_eq_self_iff_of_mem_center` (line 73), using `eq_self`. Mathlib idiom: `Mathlib/GroupTheory/Perm/Support.lean:208 ne_and_ne_of_swap_mul_apply_ne_self`, `Mathlib/SetTheory/Ordinal/Principal.lean:258 isPrincipal_add_iff_add_lt_ne_self`.
findings.issue: `exists_mem_center_reverseEven_ne_of_finrank_eq_six` states `reverseEven Q x ≠ x`, but the name stops at `ne` with no right-hand side, reading as though some other object were on the right. `ne_self` is the standard rendering of `f x ≠ x`.

findings.evidence: Lines 54-55 conclude `reverse (algebraMap K _ a + b • (l.map (ι Q)).prod) = … ↔ b = 0`. Sibling names using the phrase: `Even/Center.lean:145 add_smul_volume_injective_of_even_length`, `Even/Center.lean:173 mem_center_even_iff_exists_eq_add_smul_volume`.
findings.issue: `reverse_fixed_volume_coordinates` describes the setting in prose ("fixed volume coordinates") rather than the conclusion, and the statement is an `Iff` carrying no `_iff`. The established vocabulary for this shape in the prerequisite file is `add_smul_volume`.

findings.evidence: `namespace CliffordAlgebra` at `Reversal/Basic.lean:26`, `Reversal/Three.lean:24`, `Reversal/Four.lean:46`, `Reversal/Five.lean:49`, `Even/Center.lean:62`, `Even/Quaternion.lean:36`; the consumed declarations are `CliffordAlgebra.reverseEven` (`Reversal/Basic.lean:32`), `CliffordAlgebra.coe_reverseEven_apply` (`Reversal/Basic.lean:37`), `CliffordAlgebra.mem_center_even_iff_exists_eq_add_smul_volume` (`Even/Center.lean:173`). The need for `_root_.CliffordAlgebra` on line 42 is itself a symptom: `TauCeti.CliffordAlgebra` already exists (`Even/Scaling.lean:31`).
findings.fix: Use `namespace CliffordAlgebra` as the other `Reversal/` files do, dropping the `open _root_.CliffordAlgebra` on line 42.
findings.issue: The file uses only `namespace TauCeti`, so the new lemmas are `TauCeti.reverseEven_eq_self_iff_of_mem_center` etc. — no `CliffordAlgebra` component, while the whole `reverseEven`/even-centre API they extend sits in root `CliffordAlgebra`. The resulting split means a consumer browsing `CliffordAlgebra.reverseEven*` will not find these, and upstreaming them requires a rename.

summary: Three naming defects: the bounded-forall lemma uses a prose preposition (`on_center`) instead of Mathlib's `forall_mem_` rendering, the dimension-six existence lemma drops `self` from a `≠ x` conclusion, and the private helper is named after its situation rather than its (Iff) conclusion. The file also lands Clifford-algebra material in bare `TauCeti`, splitting it from the `CliffordAlgebra.reverseEven` API it extends.
